Fabrics compared at matched physical scale with the 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: q15 at x0.63 against y_47300, e4 at x0.81 against y_47306, q16 at x1.0 against y_47301. priorIssues.issue: w18a-2 / w17a-1 tick columns wash out at row distance
priorIssues.status: partly fixed: the pitch is now right, but the columns are wavy
priorIssues.evidence: In 25 px strips of q15 seat 1 at x0.63, the peak period is 3.9 px against 3.9 px in y_47300, so the pitch now matches. The amplitude is 0.019-0.031 vs 0.046-0.057 and the high-pass CV 0.16-0.17 vs 0.21-0.24. Over the full 110 px box the columns cancel out: amplitude 0.007 vs 0.053, colCV 0.077/0.062 vs 0.241/0.236, p10/p50 0.57 vs 0.44. tickR.png shows why: the render's columns wander and bend over the crowned back, while the photo's are straight, continuous dark channels. Close up the columns are still too strong (e4 high-pass CV 0.19 vs y_47306 0.04, colCV 0.18 vs 0.09).

issues.title: Headrest cover: flat albedo with no grazing sheen; the head-on middle covers are now too light
issues.evidence: q15 middle covers #373c55 L62 B/R 1.54 vs y_47300 L37-47 B/R 1.83-2.00; outer covers L48 vs 35-62. Oblique: q16 near L43 vs 65, row 2 L55-59 vs 77, e4 L41 vs 83. The real cover is navy head-on and silver at grazing angles. A single albedo/roughness value cannot match both.
issues.fix: Go back to the darker head-on value (#2a2f45) and add an angle-dependent sheen lobe (sheen colour ~#8a90a8, strength ~0.5, or lift Fresnel F90) so that 60-75 deg from normal reaches L65-85. Targets: q15 middle covers L40-48 with B/R >= 1.8, q16 near cover L60-70. Add the hem stitch ~1.5 cm above the lower edge, ~4 mm edge thickness and the wing logo.

issues.title: Tick columns wander, so they cancel out over a seat back at row distance
issues.evidence: Pitch is now right (3.9 px vs 3.9 px in 25 px strips at x0.63), but over a full 110 px box the amplitude is 0.007 vs 0.053 and colCV 0.07 vs 0.24, because the columns bend and drift (tickR.png vs tickP.png). Close up, e4 colCV is 0.18 vs 0.09.
issues.fix: Make the dark channels straight and continuous in the tile: no per-row x-jitter in synth_y_tick, and a fixed column phase. Map the tick layer with UVs that follow the back's vertical axis (u = arc length across the crown) rather than a triplanar blend that bends over the rolled edges. Then reduce the pale-stroke contrast ~30 % so the close-up colCV falls to ~0.10. Target q15 full-box colCV >= 0.15.

issues.title: Petal fleck still under-covers at distance, is too blue, and its dots are round
issues.evidence: q15 coverage 0.17 vs 0.21, fleck/ground 1.79 vs 2.23, fleck B/R 2.00 vs 1.62. Close up the e4 pad coverage is 0.30 vs 0.13-0.25.
issues.fix: y_fleck: elongate the flecks to ~1.6:1 at random angles, ~1.3x the area, ~25 % fewer, core L +10 %, and a more neutral core (B/R ~1.5 in the tile).
